[FACT] User is looking for a good jewelry cleaning solution for their diamond bracelet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended cleaning solutions for the diamond bracelet include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Connoisseurs Diamond & Jewelry Cleaner: ammonia-free and safe for most metals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Godfrey's Diamond & Jewelry Cleaner: gentle on diamonds, ammonia-free, and biodegradable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Weiman Jewelry Cleaner: safe for most metals and won't leave residue.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. White vinegar and water: a homemade solution (1 part vinegar to 2 parts water), soak for 15-30 minutes, rinse with warm water, and dry with a soft cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Ultrasonic cleaners: use high-frequency sound waves to clean jewelry, follow manufacturer's instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should avoid harsh chemicals like bleach, acid, or ammonia, abrasive materials, and hot water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include cleaning regularly, using a soft cloth to dry, storing in a cool, dry place, and considering professional cleaning every 6-12 months.
